effects: The signature lets anyone call delegateBySig, which sets the signer's delegate to `delegatee` (Uni.sol `_delegate`: `delegates[delegator] = delegatee`).

All of the signer's current UNI voting weight moves from the old delegate to `delegatee` (`_moveDelegates(currentDelegate, delegatee, delegatorBalance)`), and UNI the signer receives later follows it.
The previous delegate loses the signer's votes. The new delegation replaces the old one.
The signature uses the signer's nonce, which must equal `nonces[signatory]` and then increments. It is valid only until `expiry` (`require(now <= expiry)`).
No UNI tokens leave or arrive, and no allowance changes.
formats.shown: The intent is 'Delegate UNI voting power', with the delegatee as a raw address, the nonce, and the expiry as a raw Unix number.

findings.title: Delegation shows expiry as a raw Unix number, not a date
findings.evidence: descriptor.json Delegation format: {"path": "expiry", "label": "Expiry", "format": "raw"}; case 0 renders 'Expiry: 1798761600'. Uni.sol delegateBySig: `require(now <= expiry, "Uni::delegateBySig: signature expired");` compares expiry to the block timestamp.

findings.title: Delegation shows the delegatee as a raw address with no name lookup
findings.evidence: descriptor.json Delegation format: {"path": "delegatee", "label": "Delegatee", "format": "raw"}. Uni.sol `_delegate`: `delegates[delegator] = delegatee;` gives this address all of the signer's voting power.
findings.fix: Use {"path": "delegatee", "label": "Delegate to", "format": "addressName", "params": {"types": ["eoa", "contract"], "sources": ["local", "ens"]}}. Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Delegate UNI voting power to {delegatee}".

findings.title: Delegation intent omits that the new delegate replaces the old one and receives the full balance
findings.evidence: Uni.sol `_delegate`: `address currentDelegate = delegates[delegator]; ... delegates[delegator] = delegatee; _moveDelegates(currentDelegate, delegatee, delegatorBalance);`. The intent is 'Delegate UNI voting power'.
findings.fix: Optionally write the intent as 'Delegate all UNI votes to new delegate'.
